The Machine Learning Engineer - Core Signals position focuses on developing representation learning approaches for large-scale user behavioral modeling and applying core machine learning models to new and existing products. The role covers the full machine learning lifecycle, including data processing, model training, deployment, and evaluation, with an emphasis on translating research and development advances into production applications.

This position combines applied machine learning research, model engineering, and ML infrastructure development. Key technical areas include representation learning, embedding drift, click-through rate (CTR) modeling, and sequence modeling. The engineer collaborates closely with Product and Applications teams, contributes to data and model pipelines, and supports product development decisions in a growing engineering environment.
